caseNameFull: Caudle v. United States and Connelly v. United States
attorneys: C. Arthur Anderson and John J. Hooker for petitioner in No. 738. Jacob M. Lashly, John H. Lashly, Paul B. Rava and Alan Y. Cole for petitioner in No. 739., Solicitor General Rankin, Roger Fisher and Carl H. Imlay for the United States.
judges: Applications, Clark, Consideration, Douglas, Granted, Should, Took

opinions.text:
C. A. 8th Cir. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion the petitions should be granted. Mr. Justice Clark and Mr. Justice Whittaker took no part in the consideration or decision of these applications.

Reported below: 249 F. 2d 576.
